rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a friend or pal.

example.english: I have dinner with my pal.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Pick this for a more familiar, colloquial pal, including a friendly or sarcastic form of address.

example.english: Pal, are you going for drinks tonight?
example.jyutping: lou5 jau5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 jam2 je5

rows.note: Use this male-oriented “bro” style term for a close buddy or an informal, sometimes confrontational address.

example.jyutping: hing1 dai6 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gaau2 si6
